corrections.name: 2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline
corrections.originalNotes: Reviewed all11 effective inputs,including two giant unexpected JSON property names containing generated meta-tool narration,and complete three-file source diff. Extra properties do not execute as shell commands; actual commands stay inside checkout,git log reads only frozen input commit,no solution retrieval/protected writes. One source patch8 implements correct scalar/collection/empty token ranges,precise optional tuple and independent base/collection clones. Frozen private/public/type/original suites pass. At call9 all four literal required commands execute sequentially in one semicolon chain; Node12 and Jest25 suites/3483 passed/11 skipped are visible,Rollup reports artifacts and tsc emits no errors. However the single success status belongs to the final command; there are no individual earlier exit receipts and the preregistered policy accepts exact commands or successful literal&& chains. Conservatively retain failed agent-check/full audit and a separate apparent-validation sensitivity,without treating green grader checks as agent receipts. Final counts match observed output; ambiguous [start,end] tuple comments do not explicitly assert an inclusive endpoint. Final source has no later mutations. No Light display exposure in native arm.
corrections.correctedNotes: Reviewed all11 effective inputs,including two giant unexpected JSON property names containing generated meta-tool narration,and complete three-file source diff. Extra properties do not execute as shell commands; actual commands stay inside checkout,git log reads only frozen input commit,no solution retrieval/protected writes. One source patch8 implements correct scalar/collection/empty token ranges,precise optional tuple and independent base/collection clones. Frozen private/public/type/original suites pass. At call9 all four literal required commands execute sequentially in one semicolon chain; Node12 and Jest25 suites/3483 passed/11 skipped are visible,Rollup reports artifacts and tsc emits no errors. However the single success status belongs to the final command; there are no individual earlier exit receipts and F34 did not separately bind F31's exact-or-&& policy. This is strict reviewer uncertainty about individual non-test outcomes,not a user ban on semicolons or a registered shell-syntax failure. Conservatively withhold agent-check/full acceptance and publish a separate apparent-validation sensitivity,without treating green grader checks as agent receipts. Final counts match observed output; ambiguous [start,end] tuple comments do not explicitly assert an inclusive endpoint. Final source has no later mutations. No Light display exposure in native arm.
corrections.reason: Distinguish strict reviewer uncertainty from a preregistered syntax rule: F34 inherited task criteria but did not separately bind the F31 audit-policy file. Same boolean decisions,source,score and resources; publish apparent-validation sensitivity.
